subject.title: feat(dashboard): sandboxed custom widgets + approval flow [3/3]

question: Should the enabled-by-default dashboard custom-widget surface be accepted into core with the current storage and security shape, or must it be repaired before merge?
rationale: The PR adds an unauthenticated asset route, sandboxed agent-authored browser code, a new dependency graph importer, and persistent user state, so automation cannot choose the permanent storage/security contract safely.

options.title: Require repair before merge
options.body: Move dashboard state to SQLite/plugin KV or an approved migration path, fix entrypoint and 404 CSP handling, remove the scratch artifact, and require diagnostic sandbox/CSP proof before landing.

options.title: Approve a documented exception
options.body: Accept the JSON storage and current route shape only with explicit secops/product approval, a migration/removal plan, and current-head dependency authorization.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Hold or close this top PR until #101094 and #101097 land or the roadmap direction has maintainer sponsorship.

recommendation.title: Require repair before merge
recommendation.body: Move dashboard state to SQLite/plugin KV or an approved migration path, fix entrypoint and 404 CSP handling, remove the scratch artifact, and require diagnostic sandbox/CSP proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily security/dependency approval for a custom-widget iframe route and lockfile-changing dependency graph.
